mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS increases > 1% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects dim.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as related sectors benefit.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is high, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable or decreasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) suggests a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS stable or decreases
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS is stable or decreases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% during a late-cycle expansion signals tight labor markets and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4% during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of increasing real GDP (GDPC1) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% YoY and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp YoY
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 increases > 2% YoY and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp YoY, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
